title: Two saves, one play
idea: Two of Shelf's bookmarks, the back one exactly half a width to the right and one notch lower. At that offset the front bookmark's right flank cuts the back one's lower-left corner into a play, so the play appears where the two saves overlap and both bookmarks stay whole.
built: Two of today's bookmarks at 31 dp wide, scale 31/34: notch 10.03, shoulders r 3.65, tips r 1.37. The back one's left side lies on the front one's centre line and its tip line one notch lower, so its apex sits under the front one's right tip and its left flank and the front's right flank close a triangle: a play 17.1 tall and 13.2 deep (0.77, like the app's play), corners r 1.37 like the tips. Gaps of 2.5 dp separate the front bookmark from the back one, beside it and under its right flank; the rest of the back one shows as a 13 dp strip. Pair box centred, reach 32.53 of 33. A version slid further right, so the back bookmark's notch showed, was drawn and dropped: its play fell to 11.6 x 8.9 dp.
small: 48 px: both bookmarks, 20 x 25 px each, notch 7 (slope 0.7), 3 px gaps; play 10 x 7.1 px. 32 px: both, 14 x 17, notch 5, 2 px gaps, play 7 x 4.9; the pair is 21 px wide, so it sits half a pixel left of centre to keep straight edges on whole pixels. 16 px: the play is dropped; the front bookmark 8 x 9 px with a 2 px stepped notch and the back one as a 3 px strip behind a 1 px gap. Glyph: both, 12 x 15, 2 px gaps, play 6 x 4.5.
risks: Three pieces: at small sizes the back bookmark reads as a bar and the play as a symbol placed under the front bookmark rather than the corner of a second one, so the idea needs a second look. Two overlapping bookmarks is also Material's 'bookmarks' icon, a generic interface glyph. Each bookmark is smaller than in a single-bookmark mark (31 dp against 40 to 42), so it has less presence on the home screen. The 16 px cut loses the play, and the glyph is crowded at 18 px.
